suppressions.candidate: Canonical scholarship route does not inherit the legacy /form layout
suppressions.note: The canonical page independently preserves the required dynamic school-year branch and shared seal; the task contract does not require the legacy presentation wrapper or identify a concrete behavior it must retain.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat can request issued document IDs directly
suppressions.note: The ID action resolves server-side metadata, requires issued-documents:read, and for Secretaria compares the ID with the status-filtered current-document query. This is the intended ID-based download flow; it never accepts a client storage path.

suppressions.candidate: Student deletion can affect category-indexed upload paths
suppressions.note: The removal guard rejects deletion when any later student has attachments, preventing those categories from shifting. The server independently verifies every submitted indexed category.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat application or donor projections could include restricted fields
suppressions.note: Both Secretariat branches use explicit Drizzle column allowlists before data reaches the client; the related role clients consume only those operational shapes.
